Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting the sale of airplanes of historical significance from business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation taxation of therestoration, reproduction, and sale of airplanes of historicalsignificance; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and declaringan emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to the value proceeding or accruingto a manufacturer from the reproduction of an airplane of historicalsignificance capable of flight to be sold at retail or to the grossproceeds of sales by the manufacturer of the reproduced airplane ofhistorical significance capable of flight. (2) For purposes of this section, the following definitions apply: (a) "Airplane" means an enginedriven fixedwing aircraft that issupported in flight by the dynamic reaction of air against its wings. (b) "Airplane of historical significance" means an airplane whichis at least fifty years old of a type or model of which there are fewerthan ten in number known to exist worldwide. (c) "Reproduction" means to make a copy of an existing object.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
